en: Our data is spread across portals like ASAP, GSCM, BDP and NERP, each packed with reports.
spoken: Our data is spread across portals like ASAP, GSCM, BDP and N-ERP, each packed with reports.
ko: 우리 데이터는 ASAP, GSCM, BDP, NERP 같은 포털에 흩어져 있고,|포털마다 리포트가 가득합니다.

en: And then there are endless Excel files, emails, presentations and PDFs.
spoken: And then there are endless Excel files, emails, presentations and PDFs.
ko: 여기에 끝없이 쌓이는 엑셀 파일과 이메일,|프레젠테이션, PDF까지 있습니다.

en: Finding one answer means knowing where to look, then opening report after report, and piecing it together by hand.
spoken: Finding one answer means knowing where to look, then opening report after report, and piecing it together by hand.
ko: 답 하나를 찾으려면 어디를 봐야 할지 알아야 하고,|리포트를 하나하나 열어 직접 짜 맞춰야 합니다.

en: Meet Wizard. It brings every source together, in one place.
spoken: Meet Wizard. It brings every source together, in one place.
ko: Wizard를 소개합니다.|모든 소스를 한곳에 모아 줍니다.

en: Wizard's local AI has learned our portals, so it knows where every answer lives.
spoken: Wizard's local AI has learned our portals, so it knows where every answer lives.
ko: Wizard의 로컬 AI는 우리 포털을 학습해서|모든 답이 어디에 있는지 알고 있습니다.

en: So you can simply ask, in plain words.
spoken: So you can simply ask, in plain words.
ko: 그러니 평소 말하듯 그냥 물어보면 됩니다.

en: In this example, we're going to ask: how did we do this quarter against our targets?
spoken: In this example, we're going to ask: how did we do this quarter against our targets?
ko: 이번 예시에서는 이렇게 물어보겠습니다.|“이번 분기 실적은 목표 대비 어땠나요?”

en: And we'll attach our Q3 targets.
spoken: And we'll attach our Q3 targets.
ko: 3분기 목표 파일도 첨부하겠습니다.

en: First, it makes a plan.
spoken: First, it makes a plan.
ko: 먼저 계획을 세웁니다.

en: Wizard finds the right reports for you: sell-out from GSCM, market share from ASAP, spend from NERP, and your targets in Excel.
spoken: Wizard finds the right reports for you: sell-out from GSCM, market share from ASAP, spend from N-ERP, and your targets in Excel.
ko: Wizard가 필요한 리포트를 찾아 줍니다.|GSCM에서 셀아웃, ASAP에서 시장 점유율,|NERP에서 마케팅 비용, 엑셀에서 목표를 가져옵니다.

en: Then it runs the numbers, draws a chart, and writes up the answer.
spoken: Then it runs the numbers, draws a chart, and writes up the answer.
ko: 이어서 수치를 계산하고, 차트를 그리고, 답변을 작성합니다.

en: Seconds later, you have a complete answer: a clear summary, the key numbers, and charts you can share.
spoken: Seconds later, you have a complete answer: a clear summary, the key numbers, and charts you can share.
ko: 몇 초 만에 완성된 답이 나옵니다.|명확한 요약과 핵심 수치, 바로 공유할 수 있는 차트까지요.

en: Next, let's ask: where is stock building up in the channel?
spoken: Next, let's ask: where is stock building up in the channel?
ko: 다음으로는 이렇게 물어보죠.|“채널 재고가 어디에 쌓이고 있나요?”

en: Wizard compares what we shipped in with what actually sold, for every model, straight from GSCM.
spoken: Wizard compares what we shipped in with what actually sold, for every model, straight from GSCM.
ko: Wizard는 출고한 물량과 실제 판매된 물량을 비교합니다.|모든 모델을 대상으로, GSCM 데이터에서 바로요.

en: It's Egypt's Galaxy A37: its channel stock has more than doubled.
spoken: It's Egypt's Galaxy A thirty-seven: its channel stock has more than doubled.
ko: 답은 이집트의 갤럭시 A37입니다.|채널 재고가 두 배 이상 늘었습니다.

en: To be sure, we scroll down and click Check my data.
spoken: To be sure, we scroll down and click Check my data.
ko: 확인을 위해 아래로 내려 ‘Check my data’를 클릭합니다.

en: Wizard goes back to GSCM, and works out every figure again.
spoken: Wizard goes back to GSCM, and works out every figure again.
ko: Wizard가 GSCM으로 돌아가 모든 수치를 다시 계산합니다.

en: Every number is checked against its source report, so you can trust it.
spoken: Every number is checked against its source report, so you can trust it.
ko: 모든 숫자를 원본 리포트와 대조해 확인하므로|믿고 쓸 수 있습니다.

en: And every figure links straight back to the rows it came from.
spoken: And every figure links straight back to the rows it came from.
ko: 그리고 모든 수치는 출처가 된 데이터 행으로 바로 연결됩니다.

en: It's secure by design: authorized AI that only shows what you're allowed to see, and never changes your data.
spoken: It's secure by design: authorized AI that only shows what you're allowed to see, and never changes your data.
ko: 설계부터 안전합니다.|승인된 AI가 볼 권한이 있는 정보만 보여 주고,|데이터는 절대 바꾸지 않습니다.

en: Stop searching. Start asking.
spoken: Stop searching. Start asking.
ko: 검색은 그만.|이제 질문하세요.

en: Wizard. Every source, one answer.
spoken: Wizard. Every source, one answer.
ko: Wizard. 모든 소스, 하나의 답.
